items.summary: Disposition: blocked; human counsel_required. Do not authorize bounded public beta, full launch, affiliate/advertising expansion, or external rights outreach. Woot documentation confirms API access mechanics but not redistribution rights, while current Woot terms restrict commercial/public use of listings, prices, descriptions, and derivatives. Security, accuracy/freshness, measurement, and owner gates remain incomplete. Fleet compliance is technical triage only: 36 pass, 19 fail, 6 unknown, with open banner, consent, GA4, privacy, and terms findings. Analytics is healthy for 39 configured sites; incomplete scaffold telemetry does not independently block ordinary reversible growth. Revenue evidence is limited to 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate unattributed commission for 2026-09-21; do not infer site revenue, ROI, margin, or causal lift. Exact recommendation: retain the private gate and require human counsel review before any rights request is sent or public data use is approved.

Tracking remains active. No task is closed because no new evidence satisfies the completion rule. Source-rights task remains blocked; data-flow/retention, GA4-consent, and vendors/logs/incident tasks remain open. Next evidence action: attach one dated read-only bundle containing the data-flow and retention table plus GA4 consent/configuration capture, without enabling tracking, changing production, or sending outreach. Then obtain the missing Woot permission record and counsel disposition.

Data-use dispositions: Woot deal and price-history data — blocked; missing current permission covering fields, storage, derivatives, public display, caching, alerts, attribution, freshness, correction, takedown, images, prices, and affiliate use. Smallest action: record the authoritative agreement or permission source; do not send outreach. User alert rules and sync results — evidence_needed; missing data inventory, retention/deletion/correction workflow, processor terms, notification consent, and unsubscribe behavior. Smallest action: produce the read-only data-flow and retention table from existing code/configuration. GA4 — conditional for consent-gated measurement only; missing deployed consent/withdrawal evidence, GA4 property and data-sharing settings, retention settings, and jurisdictional review. Smallest action: capture current configuration without enabling new tracking. Operational logs and Cloudflare data — evidence_needed; missing log-field inventory, retention/access controls, vendor terms or DPA review, and incident/request procedures. Smallest action: produce the read-only operator/vendor inventory.

Legal concurs with evidence_needed security disposition. Fleet-doctor has no run, findings, or checks; operations deploy, uptime, and error sweeps have no results. Do not clear public exposure or security-sensitive releases. Continue the existing consolidated read-only matrix using authorized metadata and retained artifacts only. Ordinary reversible growth may continue when it adds no credentials, permissions, dependencies, data collection, or cross-site behavior.

Retain the partial-aggregate revenue boundary. Amazon data is available only through 2026-09-21; $4.92 commission is in aggregate tracking_id=other and cannot be assigned to a site. Do not claim site revenue, ROI, margin, payback, or causal lift. No duplicate telemetry request is warranted.
